hotels.title: Serene Boutique Mornington Peninsula Golf Retreat with Championship Golf Course, Restaurant & Bar
hotels.description: Set on the tip of Victoria's stunning Mornington Peninsula, Mercure Portsea is a boutique coastal retreat just 90-minutes from Melbourne. Part of the Portsea Golf Club complex, the hotel offers contemporary rooms with panoramic views over Port Phillip Bay and easy access to the peninsula's highlights - from the scenic walking trails of Point Nepean National Park to the rolling waves of Portsea Surf Beach. Golf enthusiasts can play a round on the 18-hole championship course before refuelling at Spike Bar, which offers sweeping views across the fairways. For a more leisurely day, explore the peninsula's charming villages and world-class wineries or wander down to Portsea bay beach where gentle waves and beachside cafes await.
